critical_code_review_comments: webhooks.py signature guard order: `if not CHARGILY_WEBHOOK_SECRET or not signature: 400 Missing signature`. When no server secret is set, all incoming requests (even those with a header) get 400 Missing signature rather than 403 Invalid signature. This is defensible (server can't verify anyway) but slightly misleading for callers — the message says 'missing' when in fact the *server* has no secret. Consider distinguishing the two cases via error detail (e.g. 503 'Webhook not configured' when secret is unset). Not a blocker.

bookings.py::_recompute_and_maybe_flag consecutive-stale loop breaks on the newest 'completed' booking. This is correct per the spec ('consecutive from newest until a completed one'), but be aware that a single test/dev completed booking will silence the stale-check permanently unless a new pending/confirmed booking is created after it. Not a bug; documenting for future test authors.

phone_and_flags.py: reveal endpoint does not rate-limit repeated calls — a viewer with a single confirmed booking can query the phone endpoint arbitrarily many times and each call inserts a phone_reveals row. Consider dedup by (viewer_id,target_id,booking_id) or a per-hour cap. Non-blocking.

clear_flag endpoint reactivates the user unconditionally (is_manually_deactivated=false). If the account was manually deactivated by the *user* prior to the auto-flag (deactivated_reason != 'flagged_auto'), this will inadvertently reactivate them. Consider gating the reactivate step on `deactivated_reason == 'flagged_auto'`. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-only, 3/3 checks pass (login, pay-btn click flips subscription state, bookings-tab-all testID + empty-state)

seed_data_creation: During tests: 1 throwaway client (TEST_iter11_client_<uuid>@example.com), 4 stale confirmed bookings, ~3 fresh bookings, phone_reveals rows, no chargily events. All removed in fixture teardown + explicit post-run reset. provider1 reset to clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter11 features are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_new_features.py — run with `pytest tests/test_iter11_new_features.py -v --override-ini='addopts='` (avoid xdist because state fixture is scope=module). The webhook signature-verified path (403 branch) requires CHARGILY_WEBHOOK_SECRET set — the test file only verifies the 400 branch and documents this. To test 403 manually, add CHARGILY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<anything> to /app/backend/.env, restart backend, curl -X POST -H 'signature: bogus' /api/webhooks/chargily -d '{}' → expect 403. IMPORTANT: setting CHARGILY_SECRET_KEY (not the webhook secret) would disable the mock branch on /subscription/pay — use CHARGILY_WEBHOOK_SECRET alone to keep mock pay working.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. All specified behaviors match the spec: phone reveal gated by booking status ∈ {confirmed, awaiting_confirmation, completed}, 400 on own id, phone_reveals row inserted on success; provider PATCH completed on confirmed → awaiting_confirmation with provider_marked_done_at, client PATCH completed on awaiting_confirmation → completed with client_confirmed_done_at, client cannot set confirmed (403), provider cannot skip pending → completed (400); auto-flag triggers on 3+ stale confirmed and sets is_flagged/search_penalty=100/is_manually_deactivated=true/flag row; admin /flags lists and /clear resolves + reactivates; webhook missing sig 400, bogus sig 403 (verified out-of-band), valid HMAC accepted; mock /subscription/pay unchanged.
